Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications Officer position at the European Brain Council. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to EBC's mission of advancing brain health across Europe.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress websites. I have hands-on experience with social media coordination, analytics, and event support, which aligns well with the responsibilities outlined in the job description. My work on mirook.com has involved implementing structured data and optimizing for AI-powered search, demonstrating my ability to adapt to emerging digital trends.

I am particularly drawn to EBC's focus on policy and advocacy, and I am eager to apply my skills to support your communication strategies and events like the Brain Innovation Days. I am based in Belgium and eligible to work in the EU.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Communications Officer position at the European Brain Council. With a strong foundation in digital communications, content creation, and event support, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to EBC's mission of improving the lives of people living with brain disorders.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained practical experience in managing on-page SEO, creating engaging content, and building and maintaining WordPress websites. I am responsible for keyword research, content publishing, and performance tracking using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs. This hands-on experience has equipped me with the skills to manage digital presence and develop content that aligns with strategic objectives.

My work on mirook.com, a personal project, has further honed my abilities in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). I implemented structured data and entity optimization to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines, demonstrating my ability to adapt to emerging digital trends. I am also comfortable with social media management and have experience coordinating content across platforms.

I am particularly drawn to EBC's work in advocacy and policy, and I am eager to apply my communication skills to support your initiatives. My experience in event support, including promotional campaigns and participant communications, aligns with the requirements for the Brain Innovation Days. I am a proactive and collaborative team player, with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and am eligible to work in the EU. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a working knowledge of Dutch. I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to contribute to EBC's communications efforts and would welcome the chance to discuss my application further.

Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
